verdict.rationale: Asana documents token creation and authorization for the API (asana-docs-1, asana-docs-21) and registering MCP apps in the developer console (asana-docs-39). Its marketing says agents have an identity, scoped permissions and an audit trail (asana-docs-13), but that refers to Asana's own AI Teammates rather than API credentials issued to an external agent. missing for 10: documented OAuth/token scopes or least-privilege permission granularity for API credentials, agent-specific credential issuance for external agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
